en: Jesus fed the five thousand.
So they tried to make him king.
Why king?
Because he feeds me and fills me up.

text:
우리도 *대통령* 선거할 때
어떤 사람 뽑죠?
en: When we elect a president, who do we pick?

text:
그의 철학과 그의 세계관은
별 관심이 없습니다
en: We don't care about his philosophy or worldview.

text:
나를 *잘 살게* 해주냐 못하냐
그것만 관심이 있죠
en: Only whether he'll make us better off.
Make him king —
that's what people
want to get from Jesus.
So in the end, what life
do believers want from Jesus?
There's a book called Eat, Pray, Love.
It's the author's memoir. She'd had a hard time,
and in the movie Julia Roberts

text:
맛있는 거 먹고
좋은 사람과 사랑하고
en: eats great food, falls in love,
gets married, prays a little too,
and finds comfort for her heart.

text:
제가 어디 가서
이 설교를 한 번 했더니
en: I preached this once somewhere,
and a deacon said, "Oh, that sounds lovely!"
The faith we want
is eat, pray, love.

text:
돈 많이 벌고
좋은 거 먹고 좋은 데 가고
en: Make good money, eat well, go nice places,
live happily with the one you love,
and pray for a little peace of mind —
a comfy-cushion Christianity.
